name: DhanHQ Data API v2
lawful_access_basis: Private authenticated use through an account owned and authorized by the operator under the DhanHQ Data API subscription; no redistribution.
fields: NSE equity daily and intraday OHLCV with timestamps
NSE F&O contract identifiers and metadata
request-time option best bid, best ask, quantities, volume, and open interest
expired stock-option minute OHLC, strike, spot, volume, open interest, and implied volatility
latency: Historical REST plus request-time quote snapshots and optional live market feed; exact availability timestamps retained per response.
collection_method: Authenticated DhanHQ v2 REST and WebSocket data endpoints only; all trading and order endpoints are prohibited.
retention_policy: Store immutable raw responses and hashes for seven years in private access-controlled storage; do not display or redistribute market data outside the operator's private research system.
